in_marathi.name: Aryaveer
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aryaveer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arya means noble or virtuous, and Veer means brave or heroic. This name is derived from the ancient Sanskrit language and is commonly used in Hindu tradition.
